execSummaryText: The assessed domain shows a moderate risk posture with several medium and low severity findings. No critical RCE vulnerabilities were detected, but configuration issues should be addressed.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.description: The server does not send an HSTS header, which allows downgrade and cookie hijacking risks.
findings.impact: Attackers can trick clients into using HTTP and intercept sensitive traffic.
findings.evidence: Response headers for https://example.com/ did not include Strict-Transport-Security.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS with a max-age directive and preload option where appropriate.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.description: The header X-Content-Type-Options is not set to nosniff.
findings.impact: Some browsers may perform MIME-sniffing, increasing XSS risk.
findings.evidence: No X-Content-Type-Options header present on main response.

roadmapIntroText: We recommend tackling high severity items first, followed by medium severity misconfigurations within 30 days.

roadmap.description: Enable HSTS and review TLS configuration.
Add security headers and review caching policy.

conclusionText: If the recommended changes are implemented, the overall risk score is expected to decrease significantly. Re-running this assessment after remediation is strongly advised.
